simple.meaning: אֲזַי (ʼăzay) is a Hebrew word meaning “at that time.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: אֲזַי (H233) appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Psalms 124:3, with occurrences in Psalms.

definitions.full: H233. azay אֲזַי = אָז (probably a dialectic form; compare Aramaic אֱדַיִן ) then, in that case Psa 124:3 ; 124:4 ; 124:5 , in apodosis after לוּלֵי compare אָז 119:92 .
